text: 1AIII කොˁොටස - ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ අති විශෙˤෂ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය - 2025.01.08பகுதி III - இலங்கைச் சனநாயக சோசலிசக் குடியரசு வர்த்ததமானப் பத்திரிகைகை - அதி விசேஷமானது - 2025.01.08
ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රයක සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය
අති විශෙˤෂඅති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I hereby give notice for information of General Public that roads and paths should be adopted under no of 1(X) general meeting Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha held on 15 day of July 2025 that roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths which haven’t institute an action in the competent court on or before the date mentioned in the said notification among roads and paths deemed as belonged to Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha included in the schedule of the notification declared in the Gazette Notification No. 2422/02 dated 03.02.2025 under the order made under Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 in the series of “orders with regard to publishing notifications specifying register and preparation of plans of roads and paths maintained by Pradeshiya Sabha in Sabaragamuwa province having been declared by Hon Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province” in Extra Ordinary Gazette Notification 2316/20 dated 24th of January, 2023.

I further notify with regard to the said roads and paths have been included in the schedule hereto and every road and path included therein deemed as roads and paths belonged to Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha under 24 Section (5) of Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
Samansiri Weerasinghe, Chairman, Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha.
At Dehiowita Pradeshiya Sabha,On 18 day of July, 2025.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
